referenceDps.method: Pistol sustained DPS against one static armour-1 target over 30 s (the weapon benchmark method), times the outgoing damage multiplier, with the expected critical hit, measured once the picks of each new level are made; the median over every run that reaches the level.
referenceDps.formula: referenceDps(L) = levels[min(L, lastLevel) - 1]: the per-level medians of the levels at least half the runs reach, made non-decreasing and rounded to 0.1
